description: Verifies that a bank account number and IFSC code combination is valid and active by initiating a Re1 (1 rupee) IMPS credit transfer. The account holder name returned by the bank is fuzzy-matched against the expected name to confirm account ownership. Used before loan disbursal to validate that the provided bank account actually belongs to the borrower and can receive funds. Prevents failed disbursals and reduces fraud from incorrect or fake bank accounts.
use_cases: Bank account verification before loan disbursal
Confirming borrower's account ownership before fund transfer
Detecting mismatched or fraudulent bank account submissions
Validating account number and IFSC before setting up NACH mandate
Salary account verification for employee onboarding
Beneficiary validation before payroll or bulk payout
compliance_context: Adheres to RBI guidelines on borrower bank account verification before disbursal. NPCI IMPS rules apply for fund transfer.
typical_callers: Lending platforms verifying disbursement accounts, payroll systems, fintech apps processing payouts, insurance platforms verifying claim payout accounts
auth_description: API Key passed in the request header.

versions.release_notes: Stable penny drop validation via IMPS

required_fields.description: Customer bank account number to be verified
11-character IFSC code of the bank branch
Expected account holder name for fuzzy matching
Amount to transfer for verification (always 1 rupee)

error_codes.400: Invalid account number or IFSC mismatch.
